author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the 'Mission Briefing to Tsang' Gameplay for Exodus, a sci-fi action RPG developed by Archetype Studios. Players can check out some dialogue as the crew discusses heading to Tsang, a hostile volcanic world. Exodus is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Exodus - Official 'Mission Briefing to Tsang' Gameplay Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this trailer for the new event in Apex Legends; Power Trip. Experimental Stims have landed, and they're switching up the way you play the game. Wildcard features all new round modifiers such as higher jumps, instant mythic tier weapons, self destruction on death, infinite grenades and more! Think that is wild? Well the map will rotate between Kings Canyon, Olympus, and Broken Moon every 15 minutes in a Wildcard match. 

The power trip event begins in Apex Legends on June 2nd!
title: Apex Legends - Official Power Trip Event Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Pawsome Resort trailer for this upcoming cozy life sim game. In Pawsome Resort, run your animal hotel to perfection and offer your animals the life they deserve! Take the best care of horses, cats, gorillas, and a variety of different species, and build meaningful connections with the locals. Pawsome Resort will be available in Early Access on PC on June 22, 2026.
title: Pawsome Resort - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the trailer for Lock In to learn about this upcoming escape the room game, themed around locks. Lock In will be available on PC.
title: Lock In - Official Trailer | Thinky Direct 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Looking for Fael is a narrative puzzle game in which the player sets out to find their roommate, Fael, who has disappeared from your apartment. You explore a maze of apartments equipped with a retro game console to solve the enigmatic puzzles left behind by Fael. Looking for Fael will be available on PC (Steam), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox, and Nintendo Switch in summer 2026,
title: Looking for Fael - Official Release Window Trailer | Thinky Direct 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Burn With Me is a story-centric deckbuilder filled with cozy dread and occultic mysteries. In order to summon a Personal Demon you'll master inventive gameplay with position-based synergies, and permanently burn your cards and your soul. Burn With Me will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
title: Burn With Me - Official Demo Trailer | Thinky Direct 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Solve tricky detective puzzles in a cozy slice-of-life setting in Deductopia. Watch the Deductopia trailer to see what you can expect. Deductopia will be available on PC.
title: Deductopia - Official Trailer | Thinky Direct 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: In Map Map: A Game About Maps, YOU make the maps! Become the cartographer of a small adventure crew and use proper navigation tools like a real explorer. Map the environment to turn unknown islands into a hand-drawn journey toward a legendary treasure. Watch the Map Map: A Game About Maps launch trailer. Map Map: A Game About Maps is available now on PC.
title: Map Map: A Game About Maps - Official Launch Trailer | Thinky Direct 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Begin your new job as a servant at the mysterious Vanderboom estate. Solve puzzles, serve the family and uncover their dark alchemical secrets in Servant of the Lake, a new upcoming single-player point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series. Take a look at puzzles and more from Servant of the Lake in this new trailer. Servant of the Lake will be available on PC (Steam, itch.io), the App Store, and Google Play in August 2026.
title: Servant of the Lake - Official Trailer | Thinky Direct 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Cat Squeeze is a cozy, brain-teasing cat puzzle game. Playing as an explosive kitten, use the extrusion of the pipeline, and navigate a maze to collect fish treats! Solve puzzles with precise blasts to escape, or get trapped by the soft maze. Cat Squeeze will be available on PC on July 1, 2026.
title: Cat Squeeze - Official Release Date Trailer | Thinky Direct 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue. As Anku, an Aymara boy with a unique gift, you’ll harness the power of color to shape the environment itself, uncovering hidden paths to navigate challenging and complex puzzles. Colorbound will be available on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and Humble), Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, PlayStation 4 (PS4), and PlayStation 5 (PS5) in 2026.
title: Colorbound - Official Trailer | Thinky Direct 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Discover hidden truths about the world in this 3D adventure about a giraffe with an unreasonably long neck. Figure out the rules, solve strange mysteries, and stumble upon unexpected twists. Choose your own path. Watch the Trifolium: The Adventures of Gary Pretzelneck trailer to see gameplay and more from this upcoming 3D adventure game. Trifolium: The Adventures of Gary Pretzelneck will be available on PC in November 2026.
title: Trifolium: The Adventures of Gary Pretzelneck - Official Trailer | Thinky Direct 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Stretch the world! Watch the trailer for Stretchmancer, an upcoming comedic first-person puzzle adventure where you are The Stretchmancer. Squash and stretch everything around you to solve fiendish puzzles, defeat the Claustro Empire, and save the galaxy! Stretchmancer will be available on PC.
title: Stretchmancer - Official Gameplay Trailer | Thinky Direct 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: In an ancient temple deep beneath the world, a primordial god with the power to manipulate space awakens, and threatens to bring about the end of all things. To sate the god, you have been offered as a sacrifice from the surface, and must master Dittori, the god’s forbidden power. You've been bestowed the power to split objects to be in two places at once. Watch the Dittori trailer to see gameplay and more from this upcoming puzzle game. Dittori will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Dittori - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Thinky Direct 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the trailer for He Who Watches, an upcoming first-person puzzle game about walking on walls, manipulating gravity, and discovering secrets. Delve deep into a labyrinth of intricate conundrums, seeking the god at the centre of it all. He Who Watches will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
title: He Who Watches - Official Demo Trailer | Thinky Direct 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Dive into The Granny Detective Society, a cozy, funny, and delightfully quirky detective game where you play as Madeleine, a retired little mouse. From her window, she observes her street, pins the secrets of her neighbors… until she’s contacted by a mysterious sisterhood of spy grandmothers. Now, you have a job, and you need to uncover a goofy conspiracy. The Granny Detective Society will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
title: The Granny Detective Society - Official Demo Trailer | Thinky Direct 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Mimic Meadows is a puzzle game about transforming into animals by mimicking their movement. Discover creative ways to wield this power while solving mind-bending puzzles. And attempt to unearth the many secrets of the meadows. Mimic Meadows will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
title: Mimic Meadows - Official Demo Trailer | Thinky Direct 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Open Beta Trailer for NBA The Run, an arcade 3v3 street basketball game developed by Play by Play Studios. Players will take to the court to duke it out in street basketball with over 30 NBA stars, true rollback netcode, and more. NBA The Run is launching in June 2026 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with an Open Beta on May 30 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: NBA The Run - Official Open Beta Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this latest trailer for Synchro, a turn based RPG from Komisoft! Employ your tactical expertise as your enemies will move at the same time you do, so anticipation and adaptation are the name of the game! Build up your secret Headquarters and recruit allies to assist you in the field, which you can then upgrade with better gear and awesome abilities. 
Synchro is coming soon to PC (Steam)
title: Synchro - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at Corsair Cove in this latest trailer for the upcoming pirate-themed city-builder game. In Corsair Cove, build a sprawling pirate haven, raise a fleet to explore the high seas, and take on the Crown to keep the Age of Piracy alive! From ale to flintlock pistols, and from scallywags to swashbucklers, you’ll need to manage complex production chains and govern a rowdy crew to reign supreme over the seas. Corsair Cove will be available on Steam, Epic Games Store, and Xbox on PC on July 31, 2026. A demo is out now.
title: Corsair Cove - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Dive into the Game Modes in the upcoming EA Sports UFC 6. With care and attention given to immerse players in the world of UFC! The Legacy mode follows Chris Carter as he works his way up from the bottom to the main stage! Career Mode returns and is better than ever, letting you continue Chris Carter's journey, create a new fighter or play your favorite fighters instead! Hall of Legends lets you relive the iconic fights, with fights recreated through gameplay, cinematic cutscenes and actual fight footage! 

EA Sports UFC 6 is launching on June 19 for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: EA Sports UFC 6 - Official Game Modes Overview

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the reveal trailer for Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4! The latest entry in the rebooted Modern Warfare series takes us to South Korea after an attack leaves the forces stationed there in disarray. Simultaneously, everyone's favourite cigar chomping madman Captain Price is on the run, following the events of Modern Warfare 3 and is seemingly on the wrong side of the conflict. With the series best in class multiplayer set to return, along with the DMZ mode introduced in Modern Warfare 2 set to be shown off June 7th, there is plenty to look forward to! 

Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 launches on October 23rd 2026 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (BattleNet, Steam, Xbox on PC) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get your first look at Zangyou, a disturbing psychological horror game set inside a deserted Tokyo skyscraper. In it, you must escape a hostile AI while trapped on the 32nd floor. 

Wishlist Zangyou on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805820/Zangyou/
title: Zangyou: Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this trailer for the latest addition to Naruto to Boruto: Shinobi Striker! The legendary sanin arrives, Jiraiya (Sage Mode) steps into the ring, utilising jutsu such as the Bath of Burning Oil and the Frog Song. 

Unleash the power of sage mode with Jiraiya in the latest update for Naruto to Boruto: Shinobi Striker, launching on May 29th for PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox One, and PC (Steam).
title: Naruto to Boruto: Shinobi Striker - Official Jiraiya (Sage Mode) DLC Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the trailer for the new Street Fighter 6 Ingrid Update! Featuring all new updates to World Tour, and Fighting Ground. Become a pupil of Ingrid, as she shows you her mysterious power, allowing you to take her fighting style and special moves with your avatar! In Fighting Ground you can work your way through her tricky combo trials or experience her Arcade mode ladder! 

Ingrid is out now in Street Fighter 6 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Street Fighter 6 - Official Ingrid Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the launch trailer for The Wilds of Dacrima: Field Notes from a Poorly Supervised Alchemist and his Unruly Robot Companion, a brand new puzzle-adventure game from Antler Studios! 
Explore enchanting lands, brew potions from the discovered elements in the world, and utilise your robot companion to explore the world and reach tantalising discoveries. 
The Wilds of Dacrima: Field Notes from a Poorly Supervised Alchemist and his Unruly Clockwork Companion is out now for PC (Steam)
title: The Wilds of Dacrima - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Announcement Trailer for Planet Zoo 2, a zoo management simulation game developed by Frontier Developments. Players will establish safe and vibrant habitats for a variety of wildlife to thrive in a zoo of their creation. Take part in global conservation projects, assemble custom freshwater or saltwater aquariums, and release animals into Wildlife Reserves around the world. Planet Zoo 2 is launching on October 13 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and Xbox on PC).
title: Planet Zoo 2 - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Necrophosis: Full Consciousness is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Steam. Watch the Necrophosis: Full Consciousness launch trailer for this complete edition of the first-person Lovecraftian horror game. Necrophosis: Full Consciousness features the base game and the DLC. Step into a nightmarish realm filled with grotesque forms and ominous visuals, solving unnerving puzzles and uncovering secrets along the way.
title: Necrophosis: Full Consciousness - Official Launch Trailer
